hook: Harvey's floodwater had her trapped on a roof.
narration: This woman was lifted out of Hurricane Harvey's floodwater on a single steel cable.
The storm had left her stranded on a rooftop, with brown water on every side.
A Customs and Border Protection Black Hawk crew hovered overhead and lowered a rescuer.
When someone has no gear on, the rescuer wraps them up and rides the cable with them, [short pause] holding on the whole way.
outcome: The crew hoisted her off that roof and up out of the flood.
title: Lifted off a roof in Harvey's floodwater
description:
A U.S. Customs and Border Protection Black Hawk crew hoisted a woman off a rooftop surrounded by Hurricane Harvey floodwater on Aug. 28, 2017.
